title:
Light for your calls.
Brightness for
your screen.
alt: MacEdgeLight 3.0.1 new release. Light for your calls. Brightness for your screen. A real photograph shows a MacBook and external display with illuminated borders. Ring light and Display Brightness Boost receive equal billing. The update adds queued recovery for quick boost toggles.
extra: New: queued recovery for quick boost toggles.

title:
Your screen.
Your ring light.
body:
Add a glowing border for video calls
and recordings.
note: Adjust brightness, warmth and border width.
alt: Ring light feature: Your screen. Your ring light. The product photograph shows glowing borders on two displays. Text explains use for video calls and recordings, with adjustable brightness, warmth and border width.

title:
A brighter screen,
on your terms.
body:
Use available EDR headroom on
compatible displays.
note: Independent controls. Use either feature or both.
alt: Display Brightness Boost feature: A brighter screen, on your terms. A typographic panel says EDR, compatible displays, and independent control. The slide explains that available brightness depends on the display and macOS. No before-and-after brightness comparison is shown.

title:
“I am vision
impaired and this
helps me see
my screen.”
note: A personal experience with Display Brightness Boost.
alt: Creator quote in large type: I am vision impaired and this helps me see my screen. Attributed to Richard Crane, MacEdgeLight creator. This is his personal experience with Display Brightness Boost.

title:
A recovery path
for quick toggles.
body:
Turn boost back on quickly and it queues
recovery until 30 seconds after turn-off.
note: Turn it off again to cancel the queued request.
alt: Version 3.0.1 adds a recovery workaround for quick boost toggles. Three numbered steps read Off, Waiting, and Auto retry. Recovery is queued until 30 seconds after turn-off; turning off again cancels it. The slide states this is a workaround, not a guarantee of physical brightness.

title:
Make room
for better light.
body:
Ring light + Display Brightness Boost
Two independent controls. One Mac app.
alt: Download MacEdgeLight 3.0.1. Make room for better light. Ring light plus Display Brightness Boost, with two independent controls in one Mac app. The download destination is chiefinnovator.github.io/macedgelight/. Requires macOS 13 or later; supports Apple silicon and Intel.
